title_as_printed: Molar fraction of water in vapor phase yH2O (permil) calculated from the fit in Fig. 7a as a function of pressure (bar) at 100 C and difference with the EOS of Duan and Sun (2003) (Delta model, %). The values are the mean of 2-5 measurements at a given pressure.
pressure_note: autoclave pressure; basis (total) assumed as total pressure of CO2-H2O system, not explicitly stated

value.note: value = printed permil x 0.001; derived from Raman area ratio A_CO2/A_H2O via a linear fit made against Duan and Sun (2003) model y values, so model-calibrated

notes: The authors write 'calculated from the fit in Fig. 7a'; the fit relates measured area ratio to model-derived yCO2/yH2O. Values at 4.9 and 11.7 bar have huge u.
quality_reason: mole fraction derived through a Raman calibration anchored to an equation of state (audit 2026-10-02)
